'''Whiplash''', shortened to '''Whip''' and also known by the number '''1174''', was a member of the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
While aboard the [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] he was wary of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who had infiltrated the ship. When Boba Fett sabotaged the ship, the Clone Cadets were sent to the escape pods. Whiplash was in the same [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] as [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]&mdash;alias "Lucky"&mdash;as well as other [[Clone cadet/Legends|cadets]] [[Jax (clone cadet)/Legends|Jax]] and [[Hotshot/Legends|Hotshot]] when [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] arrived in the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] to pick up Boba. Aurra Sing then coldly ordered Boba to jettison Jax, Whip, and Hotshot into deep space, which Boba unwillingly agreed to. Several moments after they were jettisoned, Whip scolded Jax for defending Boba before being rescued by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|General Skywalker]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|General Windu]].<ref name="Death Trap" />
